item.title: Morgan Stanley CEO Predicts $10-15 Trillion AI Capex Over Next Decade
item.description:
Morgan Stanley CEO Ted Pick forecasts $10-15 trillion in AI capital expenditure over the next decade, driving GDP growth. Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon notes that compute demand still exceeds supply, highlighting value in the application layer. Both executives view market cycles as healthy but warn of fragile capital structures in some projects.

原文标题：摩根士丹利 CEO：未来十年 AI 资本支出或达 15 万亿美元

Why it matters：头部投行对 AI 基础设施投入规模与泡沫风险的宏观定调，为行业长期资金流向提供重要参考基准。

item.title: Xiaomi Deploys Embodied AI Model for Autonomous Household Tasks in Apartments
item.description:
Xiaomi has launched a pilot deployment of its open-source Xiaomi-Robotics-1 embodied foundation model in youth apartments, demonstrating long-horizon autonomous capabilities. The system executes over 50 tasks across three rooms continuously for more than 30 minutes, completing complex household chores like tidying and cleaning via an end-to-end agent loop.

原文标题：小米具身模型试运营公寓 实现长程自主家务任务

Why it matters：展示了具身智能在真实居住场景中处理长程、多步骤复杂任务的实际能力，具有较高的行业参考价值。

item.title: Apple Watch Begins Beta Testing for AI Audio Rewind and Recap Features
item.description:
Apple has rolled out 'Audio Intelligence' features for the Apple Watch in the iOS 27.3 developer beta, including sound recognition, song detection, and controversial conversation tools like Live Rewind and Siri Recaps. The system offloads audio processing to the iPhone to generate snippets, aiming to enhance accessibility and information capture while navigating significant privacy concerns.

item.description:
Goldman Sachs has restricted access to advanced AI coding tools like Claude Code exclusively to engineers, barring traders and bankers. This policy shift follows an evaluation of efficiency versus risk, highlighting the tension between empowering non-technical staff with 'vibe coding' capabilities and maintaining strict security and compliance standards in financial institutions.

item.description:
OpenAI is piloting a 'Grid Protector' plan at its new Georgia data center, committing to shed up to 1GW of load during extreme weather to relieve grid stress. This initiative aims to counter growing regulatory and public backlash against AI data centers' high energy consumption and cost-shifting, leveraging load flexibility to improve public perception and facilitate future compute campus developments.

item.title: LLMs Can Read and Write Neural Network Weights: Weight Space Programming Bypasses Autoresearch
item.description:
A new study introduces 'Weight Space Programming,' demonstrating that sufficiently powerful LLMs can directly read and modify neural network weights. This capability allows models to bypass the autoresearch steps in traditional Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loops, significantly enhancing autonomous optimization efficiency and reducing computational overhead. This finding marks a milestone in AI self-evolution pathways and may reshape future model iteration paradigms.

原文标题：LLM 可直接读写神经网络权重，Weight Space Programming 突破 RSI 瓶颈

Why it matters：揭示了 LLM 直接操作底层权重的新能力，对解决 RSI 算力瓶颈具有重大理论意义。

item.title: AI Code Volume Breaks Git: OpenAI and Anthropic Build Custom Backends
item.description:
To address Git server bottlenecks caused by massive code commits from AI agents, OpenAI developed Pando to optimize existing Git infrastructure, while Anthropic built a new system called Scion. Pando reduced push latency by ~80%, whereas Scion cut CI fetch times from minutes to seconds with significantly lower resource usage. Both solutions target giant monorepos and are currently internal or shared as design concepts.

原文标题：AI 代码量激增致 Git 瓶颈，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 分别自研后端系统

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 规模化应用对底层开发基础设施带来的真实压力及头部厂商的差异化应对策略，具有极高的工程参考价值。

item.description:

item.title: MIT Weight-Space Programming Sparks Self-Evolution Predictions
item.description:
Recent MIT research on 'Weight-Space Programming' has triggered radical predictions about the future of AI. Key speculations include model weights evolving into an AI-only programming language, the merging of training and inference for real-time weight rewriting, and achieving Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) by directly editing each other's weights without backpropagation.

原文标题：MIT 提出权重空间编程，引发模型自进化猜想

Why it matters：该推文基于前沿研究提出了极具想象力的技术演进路径，虽为个人推测但触及了大模型架构变革的核心议题。

item.title: 北大 IBM 联合定义现代模拟计算 聚焦矩阵加速
item.description:
北京大学与IBM苏黎世研究院等机构在Nature旗下期刊发表综述，正式提出“现代模拟计算”概念。该框架将传统微分方程求解转向AI时代的矩阵计算，依托阻变存储器（RRAM）实现高精度与可扩展性，旨在解决大模型能耗瓶颈并确立行业新标准。

Why it matters：确立了新型算力架构的学术定义与技术路径，对突破现有数字芯片能效极限具有前瞻性指导意义。
